profile.name: Agustinus Ardhito Vedoputro
profile.title: Engineering Manager
profile.summary: Engineering Manager with 9+ years in software engineering and 5+ years leading teams, who stays hands-on in architecture system design and coding. Track record of designing complex distributed, event-driven systems (Kafka, Redis) and scaling platforms to serve millions of users at high reliability — while growing high-performing teams and driving technical strategy across business-critical, HRIS, and government-scale applications.

keyAchievements: Mekari Talenta : Successfully migrated Payroll Disbursement related services from monolith to microservices, improving performance by 12x and reducing Single Point of Failures
Govtechedu : Built a data visualization platform using startups best practices on public sector, serving 500,000+ school principals and 5+ million teachers across Indonesia
Bukalapak : Scaled systems to support 5+ million daily active users, 10000+ RPS with 99.99% uptime

Collaborating through cross-functional teams such as Product, Design, Infra, Data, Security, QA, Commercial, Technical Supports, and fostering collaborations with external partners
Leading incident responses & managements, improving system reliability through automation, alerting, and monitoring with Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, and Playwright
